content: मतिः {%f.%} [मन् भावे क्तिन्] .²1 Intellect, understanding, sense, knowledge, judgment; मतिरेव बलाद्गरीयसी <ls>H. 2. 86</ls>; अल्पविषया मतिः <ls>R. 1. 2</ls>. .²2 Mind, heart; मम तु मतिर्न मनागपैतु धर्मात् <ls>Bv. 4. 26</ls>; so दुर्मति, सुमति. .²3 Thought, idea, belief, opinion, notion, supposition, impression, view; ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम <ls>Bg. 18. 78</ls>; विधिरहो बलवानिति मे मतिः <ls>Bh. 2. 98</ls>; <ls>Pt. 2. 19</ls>. .²4 Intention, design, purpose; see मत्या. .²5 Resolution, determination. .²6 Esteem, regard, respect; बहुमतिमधिकां ययावशोकः <ls>Ki. 10. 9</ls>. .²7 Wish, desire, inclination; तस्य तासु मतिं ज्ञात्वा धर्मात्मा वाक्यमब्रवीत् <ls>Rām. 7. 25. 17</ls>; प्रायोपवेशनमतिर्नृपतिर्बभूव <ls>R. 8. 94</ls>. .²8 Counsel, advice. .²9 Remembrance, recollection. .²10 <ab>Ved.</ab> Devotion, prayer. .²11 An adviser. .²12 = प्राणः <ab>q. v.</ab>; केन विज्ञानयोगेन मतिश्चित्तं समास्थिता <ls>Mb. 14. 21. 11</ls> (<ab>com.</ab>). .²13 Activity or disposition of the mind; न मतेर्मन्तारं मन्वीथाः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 4. 2</ls>. .²14 Blessing. (मतिं कृ, -धा, -आधा ‘to set the heart on’, ‘resolve upon’, ‘think of’. मत्या is used adverbially in the sense of 1 knowingly, intentionally, wilfully; मत्या भुक्त्वाचरेत् कृच्छ्रम् <ls>Ms. 4. 222</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 19</ls>. .²2 under the impression that; व्याघ्रमत्या पलायन्ते).
